prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: high-fidelity north-star comp for a desktop web operations console, landscape 3:2, straight-on screen view. Structure first: a fixed slim top identity bar and left navigation spine; the main area is a compact aviation dispatch board divided into 待配置, 运行中, 需处理, with long horizontal operational strips representing upstream providers, public model mappings, and user permissions; a quiet usage summary and latest calls are integrated as clipped strips rather than separate cards. Product content: Token Station, 系统总览, 上游服务, 模型映射, 用户与额度, 调用日志, 审计日志, 本月用量, 新增上游, clearly marked 演示数据. The page must read as an Operate-mode admin console, not marketing. Visual world: airline operations dispatch strips and magnetic status board; warm aluminum ground #E9E7DF, deep navy #1F3140, blue-gray #496C7E, safety yellow #E0A72E, restrained red #A84336; anodized aluminum rails, clipped paper strips, embossed status stamps. Typography: compact workhorse Chinese sans with monospaced identifiers and tabular figures. One dominant move is the live strip queue; remaining regions are quiet and exact. No generic card grid, no rounded bento boxes, no glassmorphism, no green branding, no neon terminal, no photography, no gradients, no perspective mockup, no invented claims, no watermark.
